Policies and Initiatives.title: Centre’s ISM 2.0 to turbocharge Guj’s semicon industry
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Indian government's ISM 2.0 initiative is expected to boost Gujarat's semiconductor industry. The program aims to accelerate the growth of the sector in the state, although specific details are not provided. Gujarat is poised to benefit from the central government's efforts to promote the semiconductor industry through ISM 2.0.

Policies and Initiatives.title: MoU Exchanged to Establish Krishnamurthy Tandon School of Artificial Intelligence at IIM Ahmedabad
Policies and Initiatives.summary: A Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) has been exchanged to establish the Krishnamurthy Tandon School of Artificial Intelligence at IIM Ahmedabad. This new school will focus on artificial intelligence and is named after its benefactors. The establishment aims to promote research and education in the field of AI.

Policies and Initiatives.title: 1cr outlay for AI in Ahmedabad civic schools
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Ahmedabad civic body has allocated Rs 1 crore for the implementation of artificial intelligence in its schools. This initiative aims to enhance the education system and provide students with exposure to AI technology. The allocation is part of the civic body's efforts to modernize and improve the quality of education in its schools.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Now, AI to identify stray cattle in Ahmedabad, track owners
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Ahmedabad city administration is utilizing AI technology to identify stray cattle and track their owners. This initiative aims to address the issue of stray cattle roaming the streets, causing accidents and other problems. The AI system will help authorities to locate and reunite the stray cattle with their owners.

Events.title: Digital India Awareness Workshop on India AI Impact Summit 2026 and Digital India Initiatives in Daman & Diu
Events.summary: A Digital India Awareness Workshop was held in Daman & Diu to promote the India AI Impact Summit 2026 and Digital India Initiatives. The workshop aimed to raise awareness about the government's digital initiatives and their impact on the region. The event focused on the India AI Impact Summit 2026, highlighting its significance in promoting artificial intelligence in India.

Major AI Developments.title: Gujarat: OpenAI partners with IIM-A, others for AI collaboration and applications
Major AI Developments.summary: OpenAI has partnered with the Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad (IIM-A) and other organizations to collaborate on AI applications. The partnership aims to explore and develop various AI-related projects and initiatives. This collaboration is expected to drive AI innovation and adoption in the region.

Major AI Developments.title: Adani Group to invest $100 billion in renewable-powered AI data centres by 2035
Major AI Developments.summary: Adani Group will invest $100 billion by 2035 to build renewable-energy-powered data centres for Artificial Intelligence (AI) workloads. This investment marks one of India's largest private commitments to digital infrastructure. The data centres will be powered by renewable energy, supporting the growth of AI in the country.

Major AI Developments.title: SPV formed to advance research activities at AI CoE in Gujarat’GIFT City
Major AI Developments.summary: A Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) has been formed to advance research activities at the Artificial Intelligence Centre of Excellence (AI CoE) in Gujarat's GIFT City. The move aims to promote research and development in the field of artificial intelligence. The SPV will facilitate collaboration and innovation at the AI CoE, driving growth and advancement in the sector.

Major AI Developments.title: ‘Sarlaben’ AI rolled out to help 36 lakh dairy farmers
Major AI Developments.summary: An AI system called "Sarlaben" has been launched to assist approximately 36 lakh dairy farmers. The system aims to provide support and guidance to dairy farmers, although specific details of its functionality are not provided. The rollout of Sarlaben AI is intended to benefit a large number of dairy farmers in the country.

Major AI Developments.title: IIT Gandhinagar develops AI framework for pollen image classification
Major AI Developments.summary: IIT Gandhinagar has developed an AI framework for classifying pollen images, utilizing artificial intelligence technology. The framework is designed to improve the accuracy of pollen image classification, which can have various applications in fields such as botany and environmental science. This development is a significant achievement in the field of AI research and its potential applications.

Major AI Developments.title: From cowsheds to cloud: Amul Diary launches AI assistant ‘Sarlaben’
Major AI Developments.summary: Amul Dairy has launched an AI assistant named 'Sarlaben' to enhance its operations. The AI assistant is expected to improve efficiency and productivity in the dairy's various functions. Sarlaben marks a significant technological advancement for Amul, transitioning from traditional cowsheds to cloud-based services.

Major AI Developments.title: IIM-A gets Rs 100cr endowment to establish school of AI
Major AI Developments.summary: The Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad (IIM-A) has received a Rs 100cr endowment to establish a school of artificial intelligence (AI). This significant funding will enable the institute to set up a dedicated school focused on AI research and education. The endowment is expected to enhance IIM-A's capabilities in the field of AI and related technologies.

Major AI Developments.title: Saved by seconds: ISR working on AI-based quake early warning system for Gujarat
Major AI Developments.summary: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISR) is developing an AI-based earthquake early warning system for Gujarat. The system aims to provide critical seconds of warning to people in the event of an earthquake, potentially saving lives. The AI technology will help detect seismic activity and alert authorities and the public quickly.

Major AI Developments.title: Tatas to make chips, laptops for Intel in Gujarat, Assam
Major AI Developments.summary: Tata Electronics will manufacture Intel's advanced AI laptop chips and employ cutting-edge packaging technologies at its new facilities in Gujarat and Assam. This collaboration aims to boost India's semiconductor ambitions and enhance cost-effectiveness for Intel. The partnership will also accelerate market entry for Intel, capitalizing on India's growing AI PC demand.

AI Start-Up News.title: How this deeptech startup is driving seaweed cultivation along the western coast of India
AI Start-Up News.summary: ClimaCrew, a Mumbai-based deeptech startup, is promoting seaweed cultivation along India's western coast by partnering with coastal communities and industries. The company uses an AI-driven platform to analyze satellite data and identify suitable locations for seaweed cultivation. This initiative aims to harness the nutritional potential of seaweed in Gujarat and Maharashtra.
